# Laptop Recommendations for Graphic Design Students

Selecting the right laptop is crucial for graphic design students, balancing performance for demanding software with display quality for accurate visual work. The following recommendations meet your requirements for at least 16GB RAM, a dedicated GPU, a 15-inch or larger display with good color accuracy, all within a $1500-$2000 USD budget.

## Top Laptops for Creative Studies

Here are three excellent laptop choices that offer the performance and display quality essential for graphic design work:

### ASUS ROG Strix G16 (2023/2024)

- **Key Advantage:** Features a 16-inch QHD+ (2560x1600) display with excellent color coverage (often 100% DCI-P3) and high performance NVIDIA RTX 40-series graphics (e.g., RTX 4060), ensuring smooth operation for design software and rendering.
